object.description: Before installing, record the user's PATH (HKCU\Environment, value Path) and the system PATH (HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Environment, value Path). Install Mellon, record both again, then uninstall it and record both again. Expected: both values are the same at each point as before installing.
